model_specification.scaling: Each column divided by its maximum absolute value and then L2 norm; no approximate zero cutoff
model_specification.exact_zero_columns: Recorded explicitly and inactive; no nonzero column dropped to restore rank
model_specification.numerical_rank: SVD of active unit-L2 columns; max(N,nominal_columns) * float64 epsilon * largest singular value
model_specification.rank_boundary: Ranks at one tenth and ten times the default tolerance must agree or disposition requires review
model_specification.condition_readback: Exact relationship to exported singular values, then independent reciprocal-condition comparison with dimension-dependent float64 backward-error allowance. Singular-value checks, rank cutoffs and review states unchanged.
